channel.title: Antalya transfer guides | Antalya VIP Tourism
channel.description: Practical guides to arriving in Antalya: airport transfers versus taxis, meeting your driver, travelling with children, distances along the coast and when to visit.

item.title: Private transfer, taxi or shared shuttle from Antalya Airport?
item.description: Three ways to leave Antalya Airport, three very different arrival experiences. Here is what each one costs, how long it takes and who it suits.

item.title: Arriving at Antalya Airport: what happens after you land
item.description: From wheels down to the vehicle door: terminals, passport control, the meeting point and what happens when the flight is late.

item.title: Antalya Airport to Alanya: how far it really is
item.description: Alanya is the longest of the popular Antalya transfers. Here is the real distance, the real driving time and what changes on a night arrival.

item.title: Travelling to your hotel with children
item.description: Child seats are free on request, but only if we know about them before you land. What to tell us, and what actually fits in the vehicle.

item.title: Antalya Airport to Belek with golf bags
item.description: Belek is a golf destination first and a beach resort second. What that means for luggage space, vehicle choice and the drive from AYT.

item.title: When to visit Antalya - and how the season changes your arrival
item.description: Every season on the Turkish Riviera has a different arrival experience. What changes between April and October, and why it matters on the road.
